steps.command:
cd /mnt/session/outputs/coverage && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
d=json.load(open('coverage.json'))
files=[f['file'] for f in d['frames']]
W,H=670,200
per=12
for s in range(0,len(files),per):
    chunk=files[s:s+per]
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(W*3,(H+22)*4),'white'); dr=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for i,fn in enumerate(chunk):
        im=Image.open(fn).convert('RGB').crop((1250,30,1920,230))
        x=(i%3)*W; y=(i//3)*(H+22)
        sheet.paste(im,(x,y+22)); dr.text((x+4,y+4),fn,fill='black')
    sheet.save('/tmp/sheet%d.png'%(s//per))
print(len(files))
EOF
